title: Learning Multi-Timescale Interventions under Safety and Resource Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2508.03875v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many sequential decision problems offer qualitatively different ways of influencing the environment: some interventions act immediately, whereas others induce persistent effects that continue to shape future states long after the decision that initiated them. An agent must then decide jointly when to intervene, which temporal mode to use and how strongly, while accounting for residual effects and limited intervention resources. We introduce MINT: Multi-timescale Intervention Network Training. Persistent effects are carried by an augmented intervention state that accumulates and decays, while a structured policy separates intervention-mode selection from conditional control. Unlike temporal abstractions that extend policy execution, persistent-effect interventions remain part of the environment dynamics and may overlap with later interventions. translated_title: 在安全与资源约束下学习多时间尺度干预
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.03875v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：许多序贯决策问题提供了对环境进行不同性质影响的方式：一些干预立即生效，而另一些则引发持续效应，这些效应在发起决策后很长时间内继续塑造未来状态。智能体必须共同决定何时干预、使用哪种时间模式以及干预强度，同时考虑残余效应和有限的干预资源。我们引入了MINT：多时间尺度干预网络训练。持续效应通过一个累积和衰减的增强干预状态来承载，而结构化策略将干预模式选择与条件控制分离。与扩展策略执行的时间抽象不同，持续效应干预仍然是环境动态的一部分，并可能与后续干预重叠。我们证明增强状态是干预历史的充分统计量，pr
tldr: 本文提出MINT方法，通过增强干预状态和结构化策略，在安全与资源约束下有效学习多时间尺度干预，并证明该状态是干预历史的充分统计量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MINT, which leverages an augmented intervention state and structured policy to learn multi-timescale interventions under safety and resource constraints, proving the state is a sufficient statistic for intervention history.
